summary: Neuphoria Therapeutics Inc. filed an 8-K reporting it entered into a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by Scancell Holdings plc via a reverse merger. Under the terms, Neuphoria shareholders (excluding PIPE subscribers) will receive American Depositary Shares of Scancell and a contingent value right, expected to own ~11.1% of the combined company. The implied company valuation is $24.6M, with Scancell valued at $144.6M. A concurrent PIPE financing of $38.6M will provide ~17.3% ownership to subscribers. The merger is subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and PIPE closing conditions for risk-arb.
